name: CI runner host: Kueue webhook no ready endpoints — poweredge-xubuntu ci_kueue.webhook_ready_endpoints < 1
description: Fires when MAX(livespec.ci_kueue.webhook_ready_endpoints) for host.name=poweredge-xubuntu over the trailing 5 min is below 1 — the Kueue admission webhook (kueue-webhook-service, ns kueue-system) has ZERO ready endpoints, so the apiserver's mpod.kb.io call fails ('no endpoints available') and NO runner pod is admitted. Single-node/no-HA: any restart/eviction of the webhook backend is a FULL admission outage for every ARC scale set at once, otherwise surfacing only as a misleading red content-check on an unrelated PR. One-probe-interval (5 min) window on purpose: the emitter fails-closed, so every emitted 0 is a TRUE zero-endpoints reading and a single transient 0 is worth catching. Distinct from the 'Kueue controller unavailable' trigger: endpoints can hit 0 while the Deployment still reports available. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; sudo kubectl -n kueue-system get endpoints kueue-webhook-service -o wide. Emitter: livespec-dev-tooling ci-runner/observability/ci-kueue-webhook-probe.sh. livespec-s43svm.46.
